Line.description: Sankey binds rows with a source column (x), target column (group, default target), and numeric value column (y). Cyclic flows should use Network. Histogram binds /sources/name/distributions/property/bins (start,end,count); BoxPlot binds /sources/name/distributions/property/box (min,q1,median,q3,max); Violin binds /sources/name/distributions/property/density (value,count). Table with totals binds the whole dataset. Other charts bind rows. Server-bound rows only. x is a column key, y is a numeric column key, series lists numeric columns. Use line for trends, donut or treemap for shares, histogram or box plot for distributions, scatter for relationships, Sankey or Funnel for flow, waterfall for change. Summary describes the question, not invented numbers.
